passout_rescue_2.speaker: Rowyn
passout_rescue_2.text: You should thank me. Dragging you here wasn't easy!

passout_mystery_2.speaker: Rowyn
passout_mystery_2.text: Do you know how we got here? The last thing I remember was...

first_meeting.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting.text: Oh! You're awake. I was hoping you'd open your eyes soon.

first_meeting_2.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_2.text: The woods aren't safe after sundown... Not with how thin the veil has gotten around here recently.

first_meeting_need_help_accept.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_need_help_accept.text: You're right, we shouldn't split up.

first_meeting_introduction.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_introduction.text: My name is Rowyn. I live nearby, and found you just passed out over there.

first_meeting_introduction_2.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_introduction_2.text: I was worrying about what to do. You're too big for me to carry!

first_meeting_introduction_2_2.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_introduction_2_2.text: What about you? What's your name?

first_meeting_introduction_3.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_introduction_3.text: Dace. That suits you. You've got a traveler's name.

first_meeting_introduction_5.speaker: guide
first_meeting_introduction_5.text: You can press the N key to check your name. You might also want to check out the X key, it will close any menu you've got open, including this one!

first_meeting_forest.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_forest.text: We're in the Eldertide Woods, not far from Lunara village. You don't remember how you got here?

first_meeting_amnesia.speaker: narrator
first_meeting_amnesia.text: How did you get here? The last thing you remember was...

first_meeting_forest_5.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_forest_5.text: Oh, good. I thought you were going to pass out again...

first_meeting_end_convo.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_end_convo.text: Anything else you want to know?

first_meeting_forest_2.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_forest_2.text: We shouldn't hang around here. It'll be dark soon, we should head towards the village. We can talk more there, once we're safe.

first_meeting_veil.speaker: Rowyn
first_meeting_veil.text: The veil is... the barrier that divides our world from the world of the spirits. But there's much more to it than that...

scene_test_0.speaker: Rowyn
scene_test_0.text: Watch this—I'm going to walk forward, then talk again.

scene_test_2.speaker: Rowyn
scene_test_2.text: Okay! I walked forward. Scene worked.

letta_bush_first_type.speaker: Rowyn
letta_bush_first_type.text: There's a ripe letta berry here!

letta_bush_first_type_2.speaker: Rowyn
letta_bush_first_type_2.text: If you eat these, they'll help keep your energy up. They also have a mild pain relief effect. Save this for if you need it.

tua_bush_first_type_2.speaker: Rowyn
tua_bush_first_type_2.text: If we make a tea from the dried leaves, it's incredibly calming. Chewing on the leaves directly will work in a pinch, too.

first_recover_composure.speaker: Rowyn
first_recover_composure.text: You look a little shaken. You should chew on one of those tua leaves.

first_recover_composure_2.speaker: guide
first_recover_composure_2.text: Press I to open the Items menu directly.

first_give_tua_leaves.speaker: Rowyn
first_give_tua_leaves.text: You look a little shaken. Here, take some of these tua leaves.

first_give_tua_leaves_2.speaker: guide
first_give_tua_leaves_2.text: Each party member has their own inventory. You can access it by pressing P to access the party menu, then selecting the party member, and scrolling down to their inventory.

first_give_tua_leaves_3.speaker: guide
first_give_tua_leaves_3.text: You can drag and drop items between inventories, or hold shift and press the number hotkey for an item to give it to another character.
